newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso seen hovering around 30 to the dlr.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso seen hovering around 30 to the dlr.

text.p: The Philippine peso is seen hovering around 30 pesos to the dollar early on Wednesday, traders said.
"The market is still still very short. It is looking for dollars," a dealer said.
She added the peso may touch 30.80, within the four percent range agreed by bankers in a meeting last night.

Members of the Bankers Association of the Philippines had agreed to limit dollar selling rates to four percent above the previous day's weighted average rate following a public outcry over their high rates.
The weighted average rate on Tuesday was 29.674.
This is the third trading day since the central bank announced it would allow the peso to move more freely on hopes speculative attacks on the currency would end.
Traders said they expect the central bank to sell dollars on a limited basis at 29 pesos or higher.
